# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read and follow the repository root `AGENTS.md` before making changes. This file supplements Copilot's usual instructions and does not install any plugin.

Prefer minimal, safe changes (Ponytail), targeted specification/testing/review practices (Agent Skills), and code dependency analysis with Graphify when those tools are available. OmniRoute is opt-in only: do not change AI providers, endpoints or forward source code, secrets or customer data through a third-party gateway without explicit authorization.

Keep API keys and credentials out of generated code and commits. Do not modify production workflows, publishing schedules, inventory updates or trading behavior during a tooling configuration task. Verify changes and state what remains untested.
